answers.explanation: Anti-tampering helps the hardware withstand attack. The others are redundancy or rapidity.
RAID 1 mirrors. Lose a drive and its twin has everything.
RAID 5 gives all but one drive's worth: (4 - 1) × 2 TB = 6 TB.
One. The parity rebuilds a single missing drive. A second failure before the rebuild finishes loses data.
RAID 0 only stripes for speed. Losing any drive loses the whole array.
RAID copies the encrypted files to every drive instantly. RAID is not a backup.
A hot site. Fast, and the most expensive.
A cold site: cheap, but days to weeks to bring up.
Hot swap is a rapidity measure: no shutdown, and the array rebuilds while serving.
Ghost systems are listed under both resourcefulness and redundancy: spares ready to go.
